title: Length bound for queries within a run
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, let $O$ be an oracle language, and let $x$ be an input word. For every natural number $t$, each query recorded among the queries made during the first $t$ configurations of the run of $M$ with oracle $O$ from its initial configuration on $x$ has length at most $t$.
